name: Norfentanyl
summary: Norfentanyl is an inactive synthetic opioid analgesic drug precursor. It is an analog and metabolite of fentanyl with the removal of the phenethyl moiety (or functional group) from fentanyl chemical structure.
summaryZh: 去苯乙基芬太尼是一種有機化合物，化學式為C14H20N2O。它可用於製備芬太尼類似物，如苄基芬太尼。

pharmacology.en: It is essentially inactive at opioid receptors, because the phenethyl group that fentanyl needs for strong binding has been removed.
pharmacology.zh: 它在鴉片受體上基本沒有活性，因為吩坦尼強力結合所需的苯乙基已被移除。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它在鸦片受体上基本没有活性，因为吩坦尼强力结合所需的苯乙基已被移除。

uses.en: It has no medical or recreational use. It serves as a marker in drug testing and as a chemical intermediate.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療或娛樂用途，主要作為藥物檢驗的標記物以及化學中間體。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗或娱乐用途，主要作为药物检验的标记物以及化学中间体。

fact.en: Norfentanyl is what most fentanyl becomes in the body, and it is what laboratories and urine tests usually look for to show that fentanyl has been taken.
fact.zh: 吩坦尼在體內大部分會轉變成去苯乙基芬太尼，而實驗室與尿液檢驗通常就是以它來判斷使用過吩坦尼。
fact.zhHans: 吩坦尼在体内大部分会转变成去苯乙基芬太尼，而实验室与尿液检验通常就是以它来判断使用过吩坦尼。
